analysis:
## Technical analysis (Thursday July 2, 2026 — Pre-holiday pre-NFP morning)

**July 2 pre-market/early session:** $197.58 (-1.25%). Range: $193.45–$199.85.

**Gate 3 status: FAILED.** NVDA closed July 1 at $200.09 (BUY signal triggered). July 2 re-tests the gate and fails: current $197.58 is $2.42 below $200. The BUY signal is technically 'on probation' — the half-size position is maintained but full-size add is deferred.

**The critical nuance: mobile vs. AI memory.** The Apple/CXMT negotiation story drove the chip sector selloff. Apple is discussing sourcing LPDDR5 DRAM (smartphone memory) from China's CXMT and 3D NAND from YMTC for China-sold iPhones/Macs/iPads. This is mobile memory. NVDA's Blackwell Ultra exclusively uses HBM4 (High Bandwidth Memory, 4th generation) from SK Hynix and Micron — a completely different memory product with zero Chinese manufacturing alternative at scale. The market sold all semis on the Apple headline; selective recovery above $200 on July 7 would confirm that NVDA's AI thesis is intact.

**Intraday stop test at $193.45.** The July 2 low of $193.45 is $1.55 below the $195 options wall / informal stop reference. This is the deepest intraday probe since the June 26 correction low ($192.53). The recovery from $193.45 back to $197.58 by session end (no close below $195) confirms that institutional buyers are active in the $193–$195 range. This is the same defense-at-support pattern that has held BTC's $58,100 level for 12+ sessions.

**NFP Goldilocks backbone.** The macro regime held: SPX 7,478 (Gates 1 intact), VIX ~16.6 (Gate 2 intact), and NFP ~119K (above consensus but within Goldilocks range). The chip sector rotation is idiosyncratic (Apple/mobile memory), not macro. This distinction matters: if the sell-off were macro-driven (hot NFP, rate hike), VIX would be above 17 and SPX below 7,460. Neither is the case.

**★ Framework status: HOLD half-size; full-size add deferred to July 7.** The half-size position is open with -$2.51 unrealized. The framework requires three simultaneous gate closes for the full-size add — only Gates 1 and 2 currently clear. July 7 is the next activation window. If NVDA opens above $200 on July 7 and the holiday week hasn't disrupted the macro gates, the full-size add fires.
